  district_lit_decrease AS (

       WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5')
  ),
  
  -- Get the districts where women literacy increased from NFHS-4 to NFHS-5
  district_lit_increase AS (
    SELECT 
      "District" 
    FROM 
      district_health_factsheet 
    WHERE 
      "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' 
      AND "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" < 
      (SELECT "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" 
       FROM district_health_factsheet 
       WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5')
  )

  "District" 
FROM 
  district_health_factsheet 
WHERE

UNION ALL

FROM 
  district_health_factsheet
